dashboard.subtitle: Keep your resumes and job search moving.
dashboard.readyStatus: Complete — ready to tailor to a job
dashboard.errorBody: Nothing came back this time. This is usually a network problem or an expired session.
dashboard.onboardBody: Walk through these three steps and your applications, searches, and resumes collect here.
dashboard.step1Body: Start a new one in the builder, or upload a PDF you already have.
dashboard.step2Body: Search openings and save the good ones — saved jobs show up in your jobs list.
dashboard.step3Body: Mark a job applied, then rewrite your resume against that posting.

comingSoon.title: Coming to the app soon
comingSoon.body: This part arrives in the next build. You can use it on the website for now.

search.cityFailed: City lookup is unavailable. You can search without a city.

results.loadMoreFailed: The next page did not load.
results.refreshFailed: Refresh failed. Showing the previous results.
results.emptyBody: Try another keyword, or clear the city.
results.errorTitle: Job search is unavailable right now

saved.emptyBody: Save jobs from the catalog and they will collect here.

applied.emptyBody: Mark a job as applied from its details and it will show up here.

detail.goneBody: It may have just been taken down. Go back and search again.
detail.notFoundTitle: This job record was not found

confirm.markAppliedBody: Only mark it once you have actually applied. An unsaved posting is saved at the same time.
confirm.clearAppliedBody: The job moves back to Saved.
confirm.unsaveBody: This deletes your job record, including its applied status.
confirm.deleteBody: It is removed from Saved and Applied, including its applied status.

resumes.title: Resumes
resumes.uploadHint: PDF or DOCX, up to 10 MB.

files.emptyBody: Upload a PDF or DOCX to see its quality score and download it later.
files.explain: Uploaded and generated files: download them or check the quality score. To tailor one to a job, pick it in the Tailor tab. Files cannot be edited online.

drafts.explain: Online resumes you can keep editing: tap "Edit resume" to change them. Generated Word files appear under Uploaded.
drafts.serverHint: The live server may not have the online resume builder deployed yet. Uploaded resumes are not affected.

pick.pickFailed: The file picker could not open. Please try again.

problem.noName: The file name could not be read. Choose another file.
problem.badType: Only PDF or DOCX files are supported.
problem.badMime: This file is not a PDF or DOCX. Check it and choose again.
problem.empty: This file is empty. Choose another file.
problem.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB. Compress it and try again.
problem.unknownSize: The file size could not be read. Choose another file.

flash.shared: The file is ready to share or open

detail.unavailableHint: The file for this resume is missing on the server, so it cannot be downloaded.
detail.fileHint: This is a file and cannot be edited online. To adjust it for a job, open the Tailor tab and pick the job and this resume to create a new file.
detail.structureHint: This changes the text recognized from the PDF. The original PDF file stays unchanged.

draft.ready: Complete — ready to tailor to a job
draft.notReady: Still missing a name, a contact method or a target role

confirm.deleteFamilyBody: This deletes the original PDF and its internal Word working copy. It cannot be undone.

errors.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this device.
errors.unreadable: The file could not be read. Upload a text-based PDF or DOCX.

structure.title: Review recognized content
structure.hint: Check the text recognized from the PDF. Keep only what is really on your resume; leave anything not recognized empty.
structure.pdfUnchanged: This saves the recognized content; the original PDF is not changed. Later tailoring rebuilds the internal Word copy from the saved content, and pending suggestions made from the old recognition can no longer be confirmed.
structure.recognizing: Loading the recognized content. The first time, the server has to recognize this PDF, which can take a minute or two…
structure.unsupported: Only PDF resumes have recognized content.
structure.loadFailedTitle: The recognized content could not load
structure.unassignedHint: This text was not placed in any section. It is shown for reference; put anything you need into the right section.
structure.removeBody: It takes effect when you save the recognized content.
structure.needsContent: Tailoring also needs at least one skill or one experience / project bullet; otherwise preparing the editable resume fails.
structure.savedTailor: Recognized content saved. Start again when you return to tailoring; the app does not tailor by itself.
structure.saveFailed: The recognized content was not saved: {{reason}} Your changes are kept.

quality.title: Resume quality score
quality.disclaimer: A structure and content-completeness score for your resume. It is not a hiring probability or a job-match score.
quality.noStrengths: No standout strengths yet. See the suggestions.
quality.noSuggestions: No specific suggestions. This resume covers the rubric well.

strength.STRUCTURE_COMPLETE: Well-organized structure with all key sections
strength.EXPERIENCE_WELL_DESCRIBED: Experience and projects are clearly described
strength.QUANTIFIED_ACHIEVEMENTS: Achievements are backed by real numbers

suggestion.ADD_CONTACT_INFO: Add a way to reach you (email or phone) near the top
suggestion.ADD_EXPERIENCE_OR_PROJECTS_SECTION: Add an Experience or Projects section
suggestion.ADD_MORE_DESCRIPTIVE_DETAIL: Add more descriptive detail to your experience or project bullets
suggestion.QUANTIFY_ACHIEVEMENTS: Add real numbers or percentages to show the impact of your work
suggestion.EXPAND_SKILLS_LIST: List a few more of your actual skills
suggestion.SHORTEN_LONG_BULLETS: Shorten bullets or paragraphs that run too long
suggestion.USE_CONSISTENT_DATE_FORMAT: Use one consistent date format throughout

reason.TEXT_NOT_AVAILABLE: We could not read any text from this resume (common with image-only scans). Try uploading a text-based PDF or DOCX.

email.title: Change email
email.hint: Changing your email needs your current password. This phone stays signed in automatically; the website and app share this account, so both use the new email from now on.

password.title: Change password
password.subtitle: You will need to log in again
password.hint: After the change, every signed-in device on the website and in the app must log in again with the new password.

language.label: App language
language.saveFailed: The language changed, but the choice could not be saved and may reset on the next launch.

logout.confirmBody: You will need to log in again to see your resumes and jobs.

danger.title: Delete account
danger.body: This deletes the account the website and app share, not just the sign-in on this phone.
danger.removes: Deleted: account details, uploaded resume records, saved and applied jobs, resume drafts, site feedback and job search history.
danger.keeps: Not deleted by this: resume files already stored on the server, and tailoring suggestions and added experience records.
danger.failed: The account was not deleted and is still active: {{reason}}

feedback.none: You have not left feedback yet.
feedback.ratingRequired: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
feedback.commentPlaceholder: What do you like, or what should we improve?

list.hint: Fill in your real experience step by step, save, then generate a Word resume.

create.title: New resume
create.intro: Choose a template and the resume language first, then fill it in. Nothing is filled in for you.

templateHints.GENERIC_ATS: Suggested: career summary, skills, work experience, education, certificates & awards, languages.
templateHints.STUDENT: Suggested: education, relevant courses, projects, internships, volunteer work, clubs & leadership, skills.
templateHints.INTERNSHIP: Suggested: education, skills, projects, internships, volunteer work.
templateHints.EXPERIENCED: Suggested: career summary, core competencies, work experience, key outcomes, certificates & awards, education.
templateHints.CAREER_CHANGE: Suggested: career summary, transferable skills, relevant experience, projects, training & certificates, education.
templateHints.TECHNICAL: Suggested: technical skills, work experience, projects, GitHub/portfolio links, education, technical certificates.

builder.templateNote: Switching templates never deletes what you have filled in.
builder.linksHint: Add only the links you want on the resume. Empty links are left out.

fields.title: Resume title
fields.legallyEligibleToWork: Legally eligible to work in this country

hints.date: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; use "Present" if ongoing
hints.ownWords: In your own words, facts only.

confirmRemove.title: Remove this entry?
confirmRemove.body: It is removed from the resume once you save.

confirmReload.title: Reload?
confirmReload.body: Your unsaved changes here are discarded and the version saved on the server is shown.

notice.conflict: This resume was updated on the website or another device, so your changes here were not saved. Reloading discards them.
notice.saveFailed: Not saved: {{reason}} Your input is kept, so you can save again.
notice.invalid: {{count}} fields need fixing before this can be saved.

missing.name: your name
missing.contact: a way to contact you (email or phone)

generate.title: Generate a Word resume
generate.intro: Builds a DOCX file from the saved content, using only what you entered.
generate.savesFirst: Unsaved changes are saved before generating.
generate.doneBody: It is now in the Uploaded list, marked "Built online".
generate.unknown: It is not clear whether the resume was generated ({{reason}}).
generate.restored: The result of your last generate request has not been confirmed.
generate.confirmHint: "Confirm last request" resends that same request: if the file was made, you get that file and no second one.
generate.staleHint: The content changed after that request, so it can no longer be confirmed as it was. Check the resume list first; "Generate new version" makes a new file from the current content.
generate.previousDoneBody: This file does not include later changes. Save and generate again to include them.

leave.unsavedBody: If you leave now, the changes you have not saved are lost.
leave.busyBody: Leaving does not cancel it, but you will not see the result here. You can check the resume list later.

detail.deleteBody: What you filled in cannot be recovered. Resume files already generated from it are kept.
detail.hint: This is an online resume you can keep editing. Change it in the editor and generate a Word file; generated files appear under Uploaded.

errors.draftGone: This resume no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
errors.notReady: Add at least a name or a way to contact you before generating.
errors.invalid: The server rejected some of the content. Please check the form.
errors.unavailable: The server does not support this feature yet.

validation.lineTooLong: Each line can have at most {{max}} characters
validation.illegalCharacters: Contains characters that are not allowed
validation.url: Links must start with http:// or https://
validation.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date

confirmNew.title: Generate a new version?
confirmNew.body: If the last request did create a file, the resume list will have one more.

tailor.title: Tailor to a job
tailor.intro: Pick a saved job and a resume. The server does the tailoring and only uses what your resume already says.

resumes.pdfNote: A PDF is recognized and turned into an editable Word copy before tailoring.

CONSERVATIVE.title: Basic tailoring (generate now)
CONSERVATIVE.body: The server tailors and writes the file right away, with no confirmation step.

AGGRESSIVE.title: Enhanced suggestions (confirm to generate)
AGGRESSIVE.body: Review the suggestions first; the file is only written after you confirm, within 24 hours.

ENHANCED.title: Deep enhancement (answer, review, confirm)
ENHANCED.body: Check what can be enhanced, answer up to 5 questions, then review; the file is only written after you confirm.

progress.tailoring: Tailoring for this job, this can take a minute or two…

preview.title: Enhanced suggestions (no file yet)
preview.filesAfterConfirm: No file is written until you confirm. Confirming submits all suggestions below; the server may still reject some.
preview.expired: These suggestions expired and can no longer be confirmed.
preview.noChanges: There are no suggestions to write, so no file will be generated.
preview.restored: Restored the suggestions you had not confirmed yet.
preview.notConfirmed: The last confirmation did not complete. These suggestions can still be confirmed.

confirmDiscard.title: Discard these suggestions?
confirmDiscard.body: No file is generated. You would need to generate suggestions again.

confirmRetry.title: Tailor again?
confirmRetry.body: The last request may already have generated a file that the app cannot retrieve. Tailoring again generates another file.

result.title: Result
result.unchanged: No change was written; the generated file has the same content as the original resume.
result.pdfFailed: PDF export failed; the DOCX is available.

evidence.INFERRED: Inferred skill: {{skill}}. Your resume has no direct evidence; make sure it is true.
evidence.INFERRED_NO_SKILL: Inferred content. Your resume has no direct evidence; make sure it is true.

rejected.title: Changes not used ({{count}})
rejected.summary: Some bullets could not be rewritten without adding new facts, so the original wording was kept.

reasonCode.INFERRED_NOT_ALLOWED: Inferred changes are not allowed in this mode
reasonCode.UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM: Claim is not supported by the resume
reasonCode.CROSS_NODE_EVIDENCE_NOT_ALLOWED: Evidence from another bullet is not allowed
reasonCode.CROSS_ENTRY_EVIDENCE_NOT_ALLOWED: Evidence from another project or job is not allowed
reasonCode.LOW_VALUE_REWRITE: The rewrite did not improve the wording enough
reasonCode.OPPORTUNITY_NOT_RESOLVED: The rewrite did not fix the marked issue
reasonCode.FACT_CARDINALITY_CHANGED: The rewrite changed a singular fact into a plural without evidence
reasonCode.ROLE_SEMANTIC_ESCALATION: The rewrite overstated the role or responsibility
reasonCode.RELATION_NOT_SUPPORTED: A relationship in the rewrite is not supported by evidence
reasonCode.SOURCE_FACT_WOULD_DUPLICATE: The rewrite would repeat a fact already in the resume
reasonCode.UNSUPPORTED_ACTION: An action in the rewrite is not supported by evidence

unknown.runCONSERVATIVE: It is not clear whether a file was generated ({{reason}}). The server offers no way to look it up, so the app cannot retrieve a file that may exist.
unknown.runAGGRESSIVE: It is not clear whether suggestions were created ({{reason}}). This step never writes a file, so you can generate suggestions again.
unknown.confirm: It is not clear whether the file was generated ({{reason}}). You can check this proposal; nothing is generated twice.
unknown.stillConfirming: The server is still confirming these suggestions. Check again shortly.

gone.expired: These suggestions expired and no file was generated. Generate suggestions again.
gone.unavailable: These suggestions are no longer available: they may have been confirmed or expired.
gone.maybeConfirmed: These suggestions are no longer pending. A file may have been generated, but the server offers no way to retrieve it.

tailor.confirmFailed: The file was not generated: {{reason}} The suggestions are kept, so you can confirm again.
tailor.restoreFailed: Your earlier suggestions could not load: {{reason}}

errors.docxOnly: This resume cannot be tailored. Use a DOCX or a recognizable PDF.
errors.incompleteRecognition: The PDF recognition is incomplete. Review the recognized content before tailoring.
errors.noDescription: This job has no description, so it cannot be tailored.
errors.unreadable: The resume or job text could not be read.
errors.proposalGone: These suggestions expired or do not exist.
errors.badFileUrl: The server returned an invalid file address.
errors.unexpected: The server returned a result the app does not recognize.

flash.shared: The file is ready to share or open

progress.generating: Generating deep enhancement suggestions, this can take a minute or two…

opportunity.title: What can be enhanced
opportunity.cannotInvent: Related experience is never added unless it is on your resume or confirmed by you.

questions.title: Add key details
questions.none: There are no questions to answer. You can still generate enhancement suggestions.
questions.chooseEntry: Choose the related project or experience
questions.failed: This answer was not saved: {{reason}} All your input is kept, so you can fix it and retry.
questions.saveNote: Submitting saves your answers as added details; unanswered questions are submitted as skipped. The tailored file is only written after the final confirmation.
questions.discardBody: Answers you have not submitted are lost. Details already saved are kept.

errors.needRealDetails: Enter a real experience. Do not answer with only yes, 是, or used.
errors.questionStale: The questions changed. Check what can be enhanced again.
errors.unavailable: Deep enhancement is not enabled on the server.
errors.editRejected: The server rejected the edit: no line may be empty or longer than 180 characters.
errors.evidenceInvalid: The server rejected this detail. Change it and retry.
errors.evidenceConflict: You already saved evidence of using this skill. Delete the existing evidence before marking it as not used.
errors.editBlank: No edited line may be empty.
errors.editTooLong: Each edited line can have at most {{max}} characters.
errors.rescanFailed: Your answers were saved, but checking again failed: {{reason}}
errors.generateFailed: Suggestions were not generated: {{reason}} Saved answers are kept.
errors.generateUnknown: It is not clear whether suggestions were generated ({{reason}}). This step never writes a file; generating again may leave more than one pending suggestion on the server.
errors.confirmFailed: Confirmation failed: {{reason}} Your selections and edits are kept.

review.title: Deep enhancement suggestions (no file yet)
review.noFilesYet: No file is generated until you review and confirm. Unselected content stays as original.
review.expired: These suggestions are past the expiry time the server gave and can no longer be confirmed.
review.stale: Your added details changed after these suggestions were made, so they can no longer be confirmed. Check and generate again.
review.noHighValue: The check is complete. No evidence-backed enhancement is clearly stronger than the original wording.
review.discardNote: Discarding does not delete the details you saved.
review.discardBody: No file is generated. Details you saved are kept.
review.retryGenerateBody: The last request may already have created suggestions. Generating again writes no file, but the server may keep one more pending suggestion.

entry.editHint: {{count}} bullet(s): one per line, keep the number of lines.

evidence.title: Added details
evidence.summary: Saved {{saved}} added details: {{used}} used in enhancements; {{unused}} did not produce a version clearly stronger than the original.
evidence.userRejected: You marked this as not used

reasons.NO_ADMITTED_REWRITE: Did not produce a version clearly stronger than the original.
reasons.FACT_ALREADY_PRESENT: This detail is already in the original text.
reasons.NOT_A_SKILL: This is a project result, so it was not added to Skills.
reasons.NO_SKILLS_SECTION: This resume has no Skills section, and a new section was not created.
reasons.NOT_RELEVANT_TO_JD: Not relevant enough to this job.
reasons.VALIDATOR_REJECTED: This added detail did not pass validation.
reasons.CONFIRMED_FACT_NOT_USED: Confirmed details were not used in the final enhancement.

evidence.correctBody: The correction is saved on the server. These suggestions do not update themselves; check and generate again before confirming.
evidence.deleteBody: This does not change the original resume or generated files. These suggestions must be checked and generated again before confirming.

done.completed: The deep enhancement resume is ready. Your selected sections were written to the file; unselected experiences stay as original.

gone.unavailable: These suggestions are no longer available: they may have been confirmed, expired, or never existed. The app cannot retrieve a file that may have been generated.
gone.pastExpiry: By the expiry time the server gave, these suggestions have expired.

known.title: Last result saved on this device
known.note: A download shortcut kept on this device, not a server history. It stops working if the file is removed from the server.

structure.needed: The recognized content of this PDF is incomplete. Review and save it, then come back and start tailoring again.
structure.outdated: The recognized content of this resume changed. These suggestions were made from the old recognition and can no longer be confirmed. Discard them and generate again.

welcome.title: Find jobs, build resumes, tailor them to a job
welcome.subtitle: Browse public jobs without an account. Log in to manage resumes, build one online and tailor it to a job.
